goal: Eliminate all idle SSWR1 H/K heartbeat traffic seen live at 22:17 by making Whisper Relay handshake strictly demand-driven: zero H while relayQueue is empty, bounded retries only while real relay data is queued, preserving relay/session/payment/reply semantics.
notes: Live evidence after V1 showed new [SSWR1] H:hyjal / H:hydraxian lines at 22:17. Root cause: V1 intentionally allowed up to three idle startup/login/master-change hello attempts. V2 changes sgHandshakeNeeded so an empty relayQueue is an unconditional hard stop. H may be armed only by real queued relay traffic and is capped at three attempts for that queue episode. PLAYER_LOGIN parks hello immediately. No summon/payment/parser/customer-reply semantics are changed.
